summary: Settings take effect at once and can be copied between environments.

new.title: Copy settings to another environment
new.text: Settings > Copy settings exports the sections you pick to a file. On the other environment you see each setting as current and new, and only ticked ones are written.

new.title: Sort, filter and resize the grid
new.text: Click a column header to sort, type in the filter box to narrow the rows, and drag a column edge to change its width.

fixes.title: Saved settings apply straight away
fixes.text: Switching a feature off in Settings used to need a restart of PIM Manager. It now applies the moment you save.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: Admins are named one consistent way in Who gets which group, the wizards say PIM policy instead of Group policy, and record types show how many changes are pending.
